mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 40 degrees and clear at Verona Community Park under a waxing gibbous moon.

The City of Verona is moving forward with plans to expand the Public Works and Utilities facility to better serve our growing population, focusing on efficiency and green design. Additionally, reconstruction projects are ongoing for Mark Drive and Legion Street to improve traffic flow and infrastructure.
There is plenty to do in town, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run. Tomorrow, you can catch more live music at Lake Lou-ee and Paddy Mac's, plus yoga sessions are coming up on November 23.
In a recent report, on November 2, Verona police were dispatched to a home on West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was taken into custody for battery and disorderly conduct.
Satisfy your sweet tooth with today's flavor, Really Reese's. Culver's is closed right now but opens today at 10:00 AM so you can grab a scoop.
